review.reviewer: Codex gpt-6.1-sol implementation owner (self-review; independent review pending HQ)
review.decision: Ready for formal implementation and mapping
review.notes: Reviewed evidence boundaries and negative oracles. Exploratory working-tree tests ran before this repository ordering gate was discovered; this record does not claim to predate those experiments. This design-only commit precedes the first committed test implementation. Independent frozen-candidate review remains required; no peer/user approval is asserted. Uses synthetic stores, clocks and delivery; no production sessions, permissions, KB or devices.

cases.description: Continuing goal debt survives ordinary noted, empty unread, repeated scans and restart; old HQ generations are fenced.
cases.setup: Isolated store, synthetic goal/ordinary report; old and successor assessors; no live sessions.
cases.action: Acknowledge report; bounded scan; reject noted/conflict on uncovered goal; restart, rename and reclaim after lease expiry.
cases.expected: One material goal debt remains, no dispatch, no duplicate debt; stale generation cannot commit.

cases.description: One-shot stable intents separate queued, received/progress and uncertain/refused outcomes.
cases.setup: Isolated store, exact execution association, fake delivery with queue/receipt/panic/refusal.
cases.action: Save plan before drive, invoke drive repeatedly through restart and completion; ingest structured step evidence; change SID/interval.
cases.expected: Only one send per action ID; queued is not work started; exact receipt covers the step; stale SID, ambiguous interval, native/background coverage and unavailable evidence never cause duplicate delivery.

cases.description: User pause/refusal, external conditions and real questions retain their distinct resumption semantics.
cases.setup: Isolated store, explicit sourced holds, fake clock and question/answer receipts.
cases.action: Advance time, attempt unsourced resume, clear a verified cross-channel answer, check next responsibility.
cases.expected: User pause/refusal never expire; external due time requests verification; only a real unanswered question is human debt; verified answer withdraws question and leaves next-step duty.

cases.description: Schema migration, current assessment and latest evidence preserve authority and provenance.
cases.setup: Schema 1/2 synthetic snapshots, more than 128 legacy goals, old assessment150 and new receipt206.
cases.action: Run bounded sweeps; inspect shared projection; attempt body update with revision0 and unversioned observation transition.
cases.expected: Legacy goals become verify-only, no bulk dispatch; 150/206/acceptance181 remain separate; body update requires nonzero revision; relay revision0 cannot transition current state.

cases.description: Periodic and turn-boundary reconciliation use one keyed reminder with current premise checks.
cases.setup: Synthetic source/store/time/wake adapters; Stop marker in task temp; no live queue or HQ.
cases.action: Consume ordinary reports, run reconciliation without new events, mark Stop, cover or pause a goal before queued reminder delivery.
cases.expected: Unfinished goal stays due; source acknowledgement remains independent; stale reminder drops or rerenders; quiet changes presentation only; repeat reminders identify HQ coordination debt.

cases.description: Backup restoration suspends action evidence while preserving user pause/refusal and existing uncertainty.
cases.setup: Isolated backup/store with pending/queued intent attempts and structured native/background proof.
cases.action: Restore records, scan and invoke the same stable action; inspect debt and hold.
cases.expected: No replay after restore, old drive cannot prove current execution, pause/refusal remains effective until explicit sourced resumption.
